text.p: Shanghai Hero Co, a stationery maker, will make a 2.6-for-10 rights share offer to all shareholders at a price of three yuan each next month, a company statement said on Wednesday.
Foreign currency B share holders can buy the rights shares at an exchange rate of 8.2918 yuan to one U.S. dollar, or $0.362, the statement in the Shanghai Securities News said.
The firm's B shares closed at $0.47 per share on Tuesday.
The ex-rights date for B shares will be July 11 and investors wishing to buy the rights shares must pay the full amount by July 25, the statement said.

If the rights shares are fully subscribed, the company will have a total of 207.229 million outstanding shares, composed of 109.654 million state shares, 12.809 million institutional shares, 18.837 million A shares and 65.929 million B shares, the statement said.
In a seperate statement, the company said its shareholders had decided on a distribution plan based on the firm's 1996 results after the rights issue.

The shareholders at a meeting on Tuesday approved a 1.19-for-10 bonus issue based on 1996 net profit and 1.59-for-10 bonus issue based on the firm's capital reserves, the statement said. They also approved the issue of a pre-tax cash dividend of 0.079 yuan per share based on the 1996 net profit.
The firm in March posted a 1996 net proft of 45.044 million yuan against 1995's 44.754 million yuan based on international accounting standards. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
